items.english: Problem. A: subscription price for one share; a: annual dividend for each share not yet redeemed; B: redemption price; n: number of years within which the shares are uniformly drawn by lot and redeemed; x: the interest rate at which that enterprise yields neither gain nor loss, understood such that a capital 1 grows to x in one year.
